clean_pdf_page: clean a PDF page text by fixing weird spaces, OCR punctuation, split words, and normalizing
fix_split_any_at_line_start: fix split words at line start by joining characters separated by single spaces
pages_to_text: convert a list of page strings into a single text with page offsets and indices
remove_tags: remove docling or failed/corrupted page tags from text
normalize_text: remove BMP PUA, supplementary PUA, and replacement characters from text
